name: Payment Condition 2
definition: Specifies the conditions for the execution of the payment.

AmountModificationAllowed.name: Amount Modification Allowed
AmountModificationAllowed.definition: Indicates if the debtor is allowed to pay a different amount then the requested amount.||Usage: When element is not present, the default value is "Not Applicable".

EarlyPaymentAllowed.name: Early Payment Allowed
EarlyPaymentAllowed.definition: Indicates if the debtor is allowed to pay before the requested execution date.||Usage: When element is not present, the default value is "Not Applicable".

DelayPenalty.name: Delay Penalty
DelayPenalty.definition: Penalty to be applied for a delayed payment, that is when the payment is made after the requested execution date.

ImmediatePaymentRebate.name: Immediate Payment Rebate
ImmediatePaymentRebate.definition: Discount rate applied for immediate payment upon receipt of the request.

GuaranteedPaymentRequested.name: Guaranteed Payment Requested
GuaranteedPaymentRequested.definition: Indicates if a payment guarantee is requested, assuming a payment guarantee contract exists between the different actors.||Usage: When element is not present, the default value is "Not Applicable".
